question: door-hardware-sets
unit: ea (per door leaf, one complete hardware set supplied and fitted, GST exclusive)

band.unit: ea (per door leaf, one complete hardware set supplied and fitted, GST exclusive)
band.basis: Sum of the nine components above: 248.52 + 35 + 172.14 + 30.25 + 43.17 + 20.50 + 121.95 + 25 + 5 = $702 (low); 448.09 + 95 + 172.14 + 30.25 + 43.17 + 51 + 203.25 + 60 + 20 = $1,123 (high). QV CostBuilder rows used for the door stop (t22:r4, t22:r6) and the fitting labour rate (Labour Rates t0:r5, Carpenter AKL $81.30/hr); fetched NZ vendor pages for proprietary hardware (mortice lockset kit, restricted keying, EN 1154 size 3 closer, closer mounting plate, ball-bearing SS hinges). Allowances are items 8 and 9 only - about 4-7% of the total, so the band stands on sourced rates. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design/consent; excludes the leaf, frame, hanging and all machining (given as already prepped); excludes access control, fire/smoke hardware, panic hardware and access equipment, per the fixed scope. Nominal 25 leaves: $17,500 - $28,100. Alternative upper build using QV's designer/institutional Hardware-trade rows (t2:r6 mortice combination lock with furniture AKL $1,040; t24:r2 LCN 1461 REG closer AKL $800, both replacing components 1-4 and the labour split) gives roughly $1,950 - $2,500 per leaf - that is a grade choice, not a second scope. Auckland 2026, rates not indexed for other centres.

band.unit: ea (per door leaf, one complete hardware set fitted)
band.basis: Sum of distinct components, no overlap: mortice lockset and lever furniture (QV t2:r6) + restricted cylinder/keying allowance + overhead closer (QV t24:r2, sibling row for the premium cover variant) + 3 no. SS 100x75 hinges (QV t0:r11 supply-only, x3) + floor-mounted SS stop (QV t22:r4) + fitting labour (QV Labour Rates carpenter AKL 81.30/hr x 1.75-2.25 hr, hours by judgement) + key cutting 3 keys/cylinder (web, LockSmart Auckland) + one-off master-key/set-up/handover allowance amortised over 25 leaves. NZD, GST-exclusive, Auckland 2026, excluding preliminaries, margin, design, consent and all excluded scope. Allowances carry only ~4-6% of the total, so the band rests on cited QV rows and a fetched page. Band is wide because the QV lockset row's inclusions are not published (lockset line spans 1,040-1,460) and because QV publishes only a premium LCN closer. Nominal 25 leaves: 56,322 - 76,663 (mid ~66,500). This is a working estimate band for a cost plan, not a certified price. Compare with the brief's own 620-880/leaf: the brief's line prices for the lockset/furniture and the SSS closer are below NZ published rates for commercial-duty product, which is the whole of the difference.

Sum of distinct components, one leaf each, GST exclusive, Auckland, 2026: mortice lockset kit 248.52-335.38 + restricted-keyway cylinder 35-95 + key cutting 3 keys 30-60 + EN 1154 size 2-4 closer 210.38-320.54 + 3 ball-bearing SSS hinges 43.17-97.02 + door stop 20.50-51.00 + installation labour 121.95-162.60 (1.5-2.0 hr at QV carpenter $81.30/hr) + amortised setup/handover 5-12. Mid ~$925/leaf; nominal 25 leaves ~$17,860-$28,340. Low bound = cheapest cited options that still meet the spec intent; high bound = premium finish/grade and heavier-duty variants priced on the same fetched pages, with no trade discount and no margin or preliminaries (excluded by scope). Allowances are ~2% of the total, so the band rests on cited rates and fetched vendor prices, not judgement. Confidence low: two of the largest lines are 'from' prices on a single online trade list with function/finish variants, QV hardware rows are unreviewed, and the restricted-cylinder figure may overlap the key-cutting line.
